description.zh: 蓝军兵败中原，退守东南小岛。建设农田、金矿与兵营积蓄力量，训练五大兵种，时机成熟即可挥师反攻：连下五镇、大破红方都城，统一中原。经营与出征自由安排，红方也会定期反扑，考验你的备战节奏。
description.en: Defeated on the mainland, the Blue army retreats to a remote island in the southeast. Build farms, gold mines and barracks, train five unit types, then launch your counterattack: capture five towns, storm the Red capital and reunify the realm. Develop and attack at your own pace - Red raids keep the pressure on.

controls.zh: 点击 / 触摸：选择建筑与兵种、放置建筑、出征选关；资源自动产出，红方每 90 秒反扑一次，打退可缴获资源
controls.en: Click / tap: pick buildings & units, place buildings, choose campaign stages. Resources accumulate automatically; Red raids every 90s - win them for bonus loot
